converter.title: File Converter
converter.desc: Audio, video and images to MP3, WAV, MP4, GIF, PNG, WebP and more, also resized or rotated. Right-click a file in Explorer to convert it without opening the app.

compressor.desc: Makes photos, music, videos, PDFs and any other file smaller, up to 10 at a time, and shows how much it saved. Also from the right-click menu.

player.title: Built-in player
player.desc: Preview any file: photos, videos, music with a live spectrum, PDFs. Speed, loop, ±10 s and a smooth seek bar with the Sophy mark.

downloads.title: Smarter downloads
downloads.desc: Files never overwrite each other anymore, each gets a Sophy ID, and Instagram posts can be downloaded photo by photo.

home.converterDesc: Turn audio, video and images into other formats, resize or rotate them. Also from Explorer's right-click menu.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Folder paths, visual themes, and language configuration.
settings.folderPathsDesc: Customize destination folders individually for each download type.

settings.relSunoDesc: Download Suno tracks as 320k MP3, uncompressed WAV, original stream, cover art, and synced lyrics (.lrc/.txt). Left slide-over history drawer with instant search.
settings.relUniDesc: One-click MP4 video & MP3 audio conversion from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Twitter/X and more. Sortable (A-Z, date) and filterable media history.
settings.relEssentiaDesc: High-accuracy Camelot key detection with 12-Chroma HPCP, harmonic mixing matches, half/double tempo, and precision BPM fine-tuning.
settings.relMetaDesc: Edit song title, artist, album, and year for MP3, WAV, FLAC, and M4A files; swap album art instantly and embed tags via ID3v2.4 directly.
settings.relFolderDesc: Separate destination paths for All (.zip), Audio, Cover Art, Lyrics, and Universal Media. Offline Manrope typography, 6 accent colors, 3 theme modes, and 8 languages.
settings.appearanceDesc: Pick how Sophy Studio looks. Changes apply right away.
